title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song! — Episode4 Empathy

meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Miku sounded way better than this during the girls' show.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They launched everyone sky high just through their singing.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Which means I gotta figure out a way to sing like Miku did that time...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm playing my guitar just fine, but I'm not as happy with my singing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Miku? What did you feel as you sang during the girls' show...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I was definitely having fun. It felt wonderful knowing that my singing was helping bring everybody together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not much other than that to be honest.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Also, well...
When I was singing, I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I tried to tell the girls that they can play even better. That they can keep going.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that sense, I sang with the hope to propel them forward.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The hope to propel them forward...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I realized something after spending so much time with them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We may not be able to do much for them directly, but we can think about things and try to come up with good solutions together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Singing is the same. You can't solve people's problems directly with it, but you can move them or show support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I wanted to sing in a way that would help Ichika and the others achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanted to help the girls move forward even just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I have a much better idea of what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome, and good luck.
I'll be heading back to practice now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! See you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
There's something shining by that chair...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Did Rin drop it?
Saki did just get her some new accessories.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess I should pick it up for her and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Kanade's song really does have this warmth to it...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's like it knows how to meld with your heart and comfort you in just the right way...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (When Miku sang that time, she must've done so to try to convey Kanade's feelings and comfort Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna learn how to sing like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki and Ena bought some snacks for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A-And we were looking for Rin...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin wants to focus on what she's doing right now, so you shouldn't disturb her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Is something bothering her...?
Are you sure she doesn't need our help...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nothing's bothering her.
It's just... I'm sure she'll come see you when she feels she's ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We understand...
For now, let's go join the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll set aside some of these for Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-So, um... MEIKO, you're welcome to join us. We'll be just over there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I can't do what Rin's doing right now...)
